name: WeKnora Read-only Bridge
description: Optional read-only bridge to a WeKnora HTTP/MCP endpoint. Disabled by default. Set WEKNORA_BASE_URL (+ API key in config) when you want remote KB search; local SQLite remains the default.

config.notes: Leave url empty until WEKNORA_BASE_URL is available. Point url at the WeKnora OpenAI/MCP-compatible base (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). NLM does not clone WeKnora Wiki/GraphRAG — this is a thin remote search stub only.
